title: Event Sourcing
subtitle: Keep every change as an event and derive the state, and use snapshots so replays stay short
motto: Store what happened, and work out what is true
keyInsight: Event sourcing gives a full audit trail and the ability to rebuild any view, at about a hundred times the storage of current state and a replay time that grows until snapshots cap it.

decisions.title: Report the storage next to the history
decisions.description: Every frame shows storage and the number of events kept, so the audit trail is priced in gigabytes.
decisions.alternatives: Praising the audit trail alone would hide that events take about a hundred times the space of one state row.

decisions.title: Fail with the account that never stops
decisions.description: The failure frame replays a very active account from its first event, since the aggregate that grows without limit is what makes replay slow.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only accounts with a few hundred events would make replay look free.
